readme:
# Tori.fi Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [Tori.fi](https://www.tori.fi), the Finnish online classifieds marketplace. Paste any Tori.fi search URL with your filters applied and get one row per listing: title, price, location, brand, seller, image and posting age. Turn on details to add the condition, item attributes, full description, category path, all images and the last edit time.

## What you can do with it

- Track prices for a product, brand or category across Finland.
- Monitor new listings in a city or region by saving a filtered search URL and running the actor on a schedule.
- Build a price database for used goods (phones, bikes, furniture and more).
- Collect seller names of businesses that advertise on Tori.fi.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `searchUrls` | array of strings | the example search in the prefill | Tori.fi search URLs. Each URL is paginated automatically. A single URL as a string also works. If empty or missing, the example search from the prefill is used. |
| `maxResults` | integer | 10 | Maximum listings in total across all URLs (0 = unlimited, max 10000). |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | 100 | Maximum listings per search URL (0 = unlimited, max 10000). |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | false | Open every listing page for the full description, category path, all images and the last edit time. |

An empty input `{}` runs the example search and returns up to 10 listings. Numbers given as text (`"50"`) are accepted.

### Example: one search with details

```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?q=iphone"],
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

### Example: several searches in one run

```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?q=iphone",
    "https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?category=0.93&condition=1&location=0.100013&price_to=150"
  ],
  "maxResults": 200,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 100
}
```

### Example: quick scan without details

```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?q=polkupyora"],
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

### Supported URL formats

| URL | Example |
|-----|---------|
| Keyword search | `https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?q=iphone` |
| Search with filters (category, location, condition, price) | `https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?category=0.93&condition=1&location=0.100013&price_to=150` |

Set the filters on tori.fi, then copy the address bar. A `page` parameter in the URL is ignored, paging starts at page 1.

## Output

Each row is one listing. Fields marked "details" are empty unless `includeDetails` is on.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Tori listing ID |
| `title` | string | Listing title |
| `description` | string or null | Listing text (details) |
| `price` | number or null | Price |
| `currency` | string or null | Currency code, `EUR` |
| `location` | string or null | Area and city as shown on the card, e.g. `Karjasilta, Oulu` |
| `category` | string or null | Category path, e.g. `Elektroniikka ja kodinkoneet > Puhelimet ja tarvikkeet > Matkapuhelimet` (details) |
| `brand` | string or null | Brand, when the listing has one |
| `condition` | string or null | Condition from the listing's Kunto chip: `New`, `Like new`, `Good`, `Fair`, `Poor` (details) |
| `condition_text` | string or null | The Kunto label exactly as the site shows it, e.g. `Kuin uusi`, `Hyvä` (details) |
| `image_url` | string or null | Main image URL |
| `image_urls` | array | Image URLs: one without details, all listing images with details |
| `seller` | string or null | Seller name when the card shows one. Private sellers usually show no name |
| `posted_at` | string or null | Approximate ISO timestamp computed from the age on the card |
| `posted_at_text` | string or null | Age exactly as the card shows it: `15 min`, `3 t` (hours), `2 pv` (days), `1 vk` (weeks), `1 kk` (months) |
| `edited_at` | string or null | Last edit time of the listing, ISO (details) |
| `attributes` | object or null | Item chips as label to value, e.g. `Kunto`, `Merkki`, `Muisti`, `Malli`. The labels depend on the category (details) |
| `source_url` | string | Link to the listing on Tori.fi |
| `search_query` | string or null | The search URL that produced the row |
| `scraped_at` | string | ISO timestamp of the scrape |

`posted_at` is rounded to the unit the site shows, so "3 t" means about three hours ago. Use `edited_at` with details when you need an exact time.

### Sample row

```json
{
  "id": "49057887",
  "title": "APPLE IPHONE 14 128GB ( VALKONEN )",
  "description": "Moikka! olisi minulle jäänyt alle viikko sitten täysin ylimääräseksi tämä kyseinen iphone 14 ...",
  "price": 300,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "location": "Viitasaari Keskus, Viitasaari",
  "category": "Elektroniikka ja kodinkoneet > Puhelimet ja tarvikkeet > Matkapuhelimet",
  "brand": "Apple",
  "condition": "Good",
  "condition_text": "Hyvä",
  "image_url": "https://img.tori.net/dynamic/1280w/item/49057887/3e88d0bd-ece8-4f45-8473-a0d9731bc25d",
  "image_urls": ["https://img.tori.net/dynamic/default/item/49057887/3e88d0bd-ece8-4f45-8473-a0d9731bc25d"],
  "seller": null,
  "posted_at": "2026-10-26T03:44:31.294Z",
  "posted_at_text": "3 t",
  "edited_at": "2026-10-26T03:26:04.217Z",
  "attributes": {"Kunto": "Hyvä", "Merkki": "Apple", "Muisti": "128 GB", "Malli": "iPhone 14/Mini/Plus/Pro/Max"},
  "source_url": "https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/item/49057887",
  "search_query": "https://www.tori.fi/recommerce/forsale/search?q=iphone",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-26T06:44:31.294Z"
}
```

## Pricing

Pay per event. You pay a small start fee per run plus one event per listing. A listing is charged once, at the basic or the detail rate.

| Event | Cost | Triggered by |
|-------|------|--------------|
| Run start | $0.001 per run | Each run |
| `directory-serp-result` | $0.002 per listing | Each listing delivered without details |
| `directory-detail-result` | $0.005 per listing | Each listing delivered with `includeDetails` on (instead of the basic event) |

**100 listings = $0.201** without details, **$0.501** with details.

The actor stops delivering when your run's maximum total charge is reached and ends with the status "Stopped at the max charge limit. N listings delivered." You are never charged for listings that were not delivered.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client. Add the Apify MCP server to your client configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "apify": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/tori-fi-scraper",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

You can also copy the setup from the [MCP tab of this actor](https://console.apify.com/actors/tqZCdbYvYkVlYHZlT/info/api/mcp?build=latest) in the Apify Console.

Example prompt: "Use `tori-fi-scraper` to list the 30 newest used iPhone 13 listings in Helsinki under 300 EUR and show them as a table."

## FAQ

**How do I get a search URL?**
Open [tori.fi](https://www.tori.fi), search and set your filters, then copy the URL from the address bar.

**Why is `seller` empty on many rows?**
The listing card only shows a name for business sellers. Private sellers show none.

**Why are `description` and `category` empty?**
They come from the listing page. Turn on `includeDetails`.

**How do I get only new listings?**
Run the actor on a schedule with the same search URL and compare the `id` values with your previous run. `posted_at` helps to spot fresh listings.

**How do I stop at a budget?**
Set the maximum total charge for the run in the Apify Console. The actor stops at that limit and reports how many listings it delivered.

**What does an empty result mean?**
If your search has no hits the run succeeds with zero rows and the status "No listings found for this search."
